scope: Materialize, deterministically scan, and compatibly score only the two frozen primary repositories. Packet selection, human review, the reserve source, providers, tuning, and gate promotion are excluded.
preconditions: The implementation commit contains exact-commit ingest and deterministic-only detection controls.
The current persistent store is backed up before the first mutation and no alternate store is substituted.
All production scanner binaries are available at their pinned versions and the complete scanner canary passes.
The frozen protocol and this receipt digests match the approved files.
No source has an existing repo_id or evaluation-family collision.
commands_in_order: uv run repoauditor ingest https://github.com/documenso/documenso.git --repo-id opt002-documenso --expected-commit f0ab7c112e3c39656b0153b67fbf25fd9616e96f
uv run repoauditor ingest https://github.com/lobsters/lobsters.git --repo-id opt002-lobsters --expected-commit 57268d762e1c2c95b7a8e64ee8deb259cddd8cc0

resource_ceilings.network_reads: Only the two frozen public Git repositories and scanner-owned public rule/advisory data required by the pinned deterministic adapters.

stop_conditions: Any full commit, stored commit, source identity, or snapshot digest differs from the frozen source.
The scanner canary fails or any applicable scanner reports failed, partial, unavailable, malformed, unknown, or unexplained zero-target execution.
Any provider call, token, cost, map-stage record, or nonzero LLM region is observed.
Either nonempty triage result uses a scoring identity different from the frozen tuple.
A repository identity or evaluation family collides with existing evidence.
A resource ceiling is reached, disk usage is unknown, or an output would overwrite an existing artifact.

required_per_source: resolved full commit and stored commit
snapshot tree digest and byte count
per-scanner status, applicability, version, configuration identity, target count, finding count, and raw artifact digest
model-run id and complete scoring identity
triage feature, score, and unassessed candidate counts
provider calls, tokens, and cost, all exactly zero
required_aggregate: eligible production/deployment candidate count before packet selection
whether the reserve activation condition is met without activating it
result_contract.packet_selection: excluded; a result PR must first prove identities and counts, then freeze the outcome-blind packet without exposing scores to reviewers

authorization.required_statement: I authorize the OPT-002 primary zero-provider execution described by opt-002-primary-execution-receipt-2026-08-07.json, limited to its two frozen primary repositories, deterministic scanner network reads, current persistent store, 5 GiB new-data ceiling, 120 minutes per repository, and exactly zero provider calls, tokens, uploads, and cost. The reserve, packet review, providers, tuning, and gate promotion remain excluded.
